author: Ogrey
body:
Hey guys! Halloween is coming, and I took some hours of my drawing time to make a halloween-themed Nebula map!

Arizona is a DTM map with two monuments for each team. Each monument is inside an oak-roof house. The map has two gold mines at each of the front sandstone-roof houses, and there are some iron blocks lying in there as well! The map is built to last a good amount of time, so yeah, I hope it plays well ^_^

Map Name: Arizona
Map Creator: Evocal
Server Provided by: alexanderjoe10
Basic Info:
- Destroy the Monument (2 Monuments)
- Yellow vs Pink (25 vs 25)
- Gold and Iron, no Diamonds
- A lot of structures (easy to destroy, as well)
- Halloweenized

Map Images:
